title: Entire 1500-tick golden hash stream replaced under an unchanged seed, masking where divergence begins
detail: The fixed seed (3003) and tick count (1500) are unchanged, yet every per-tick hash changed with zero overlap between old and new values. Full re-roll from tick 1 suggests either a global behavior change or a regenerated artifact that hides the true first-divergence point.
recommended_fix: Verify the change legitimately alters tick-1 behavior. If not, regenerate the golden from the unmodified baseline and diff tick-by-tick to confirm divergence starts at the intended tick.

title: catalog_hash changed while scenario name, seed, and ticks stay identical — no version bump records the catalog change
detail: The scenario is still "demo qos" with the same seed and duration, but its catalog hash changed. Nothing in the file records what changed in the catalog or why, making this golden update untriagable from the t1 alone.
recommended_fix: Document the catalog delta in the commit message, or bump the scenario name/version alongside catalog_hash so catalog changes are traceable in the golden's own metadata.

title: Binary golden artifacts (log and screenshot) are un-reviewable in diff form
evidence:
Binary files a/goldens/qos.log.bin and b/goldens/qos.log.bin differ
Binary files a/goldens/qos/65000ms.png and b/goldens/qos/65000ms.png differ
detail: Both binary goldens changed, but a binary diff gives reviewers zero visibility into what changed or whether it corresponds to the tick-hash changes in qos.t1. Reviewers must take both on faith.
recommended_fix: Commit the log as text (if it is line-oriented) and require an annotated screenshot diff (e.g. side-by-side render) in the PR description when image goldens change.
